name: GetBaseAmount
lifetime: Borrowed packet-local live wrapper; copy GetModifiedValue to an immutable Lua number before SetBaseAmount if the old numeric value must survive mutation
notes: Returns the packet's UpgradedValue-compatible wrapper. Stock scripts call GetModifiedValue for the numeric amount or mutate the wrapper. Live Ice Wave trace proved a retained wrapper is not a numeric snapshot: after SetBaseAmount changed the packet from 1771 to 5313, the retained wrapper also read 5313. Preserve a required old value as a Lua number and construct a new wrapper when restoring.
